page.overview:
Who is Big Mom Pirates?

Organization:At least 10,121,500,00010,121,500,000}}At least 11,044,500,00010,121,500,000Sun Pirates - At least 438,000,000Fire Tank Pirates - At least 485,000,000}}

The Big Mom Pirates are an extremely infamous and powerful pirate crew led by their captain, Charlotte Linlin, better known as "Big Mom", formerly one of the Four Emperors. They are in control of the powerful nation of Totto Land, with their captain ruling it as its queen and their base of operations being Whole Cake Island, the country's main island. The captain agreed to an alliance with the Beasts Pirates for plans to take over the world. However, the captain was defeated during the Raid on Onigashima by Eustass Kid and Trafalgar Law of the Worst Generation, and she was subsequently stripped of her position as an Emperor, leaving the crew's status unknown.

Due to their actions and role, they are minor antagonists during the Fish-Man Island Arc, Dressrosa Arc, and Zou Arc, and the main antagonists of the Whole Cake Island Arc and Whole Cake Island Saga as a whole.

The Big Mom Pirates' Jolly Roger is a skull with thick lips and wearing a pirate tricorne based on their captain's appearance, on a fluffy background (which could represent Linlin's hair in some fashion) with several candy canes crossed behind it (one on the right, three stacked together on the left), in place of normal crossbones. A tree is seen coming out of the cane on the bottom right.
